factual_annotations: One fresh confirmation was executed. All three physical metrics match this development observation exactly; no deterministic or statistical reproducibility guarantee follows.
The principal wording "no replication" does not erase the fresh confirmation; no broader repeatability campaign was performed.

limitations: No feasible design was found; this is not a claim that no feasible design exists - only that none was observed within the four evaluated designs.
Only 4 evaluations on a single development seed (17); no replication, so no statistical variance or robustness statement.

Unsearched scope remains: segment_count 2 (bounds [2,4]); proximal_tendons=4 (both declared signatures use proximal=3); the holding_tip_speed_weight axis 0.025-0.1 was never moved from 0.05; length allocations were explored only along length/0 within the frozen +/-5% band about the topology-dependent baseline ([0.16, equal shares of 0.11]).

Confirmation is a single exact re-run of the same deterministic pipeline and cannot establish statistical reproducibility; the two stiff holding speeds 0.09248005 and 0.21090378 in history remain individual observations, not variance or proof of bugs.
Sum of tension limits is not tip force or power, and motor mass is unknown; the fewer-actuator preference is unexercised because no design was accepted.
Material was frozen to baseline and section/routing scales to 1.0, so no compliant/stiff or geometry-scaling alternatives were considered.
No global optimum, real-time, arbitrary-topology, or robustness claims are made; the original historical T0 result remains valid in its own scope.
